description:
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Mirrormade by paying {1}{U}{U}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ancient Den.
Activate Mirrormade by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Tameshi's second ability by paying {W} and returning Mirrormade from the battlefield to your hand, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
